description: What a fishing region needs, independently of which organization supplies it. A source binding is not proof of regional coverage.

needs.name: Seabed depth and relief
needs.question: What is the shape and depth of the bottom here?
needs.cadence: Check catalog monthly; rebuild only after a reviewed survey change.
needs.must_not_infer: A coarse grid cannot identify boulder dimensions, overhangs or small caves.

needs.name: Rock, sand, mud and habitat edges
needs.question: What is the seabed made of, and how was it verified?
needs.cadence: Monthly catalog check; reviewed release updates.
needs.must_not_infer: Backscatter brightness alone is not rock hardness or fish abundance.

needs.name: Underwater imagery and samples
needs.question: Are local rock forms and substrate directly observed?
needs.cadence: Quarterly source discovery; import dated observations.
needs.must_not_infer: A nearby camera tow is not a photograph at a target unless positions and accuracy support that match.

needs.name: Kelp canopy and vegetated habitat
needs.question: Where is vegetation observed, and how recently?
needs.cadence: Latest usable satellite or seasonal survey release.
needs.must_not_infer: No surface canopy detection does not prove no submerged kelp.

needs.name: Protected-area boundaries
needs.question: Which areas must be excluded from fishing layers?
needs.cadence: Daily source check and refresh while app is open.
needs.must_not_infer: A successful empty response does not prove an area has no closures.

needs.name: Species, season, size, bag and gear rules
needs.question: Which rules apply to this species, jurisdiction, date and gear?
needs.cadence: Daily check plus in-season change review.
needs.must_not_infer: An unchanged or accessible page is not an automated legal interpretation.

needs.name: In-season, health, whale-risk and security restrictions
needs.question: Has an exceptional closure or gear restriction changed access?
needs.cadence: Daily, plus official notices before a trip.
needs.must_not_infer: A normal season table cannot override an emergency closure.

needs.name: Hourly wind, gust and visibility forecast
needs.question: What will conditions be throughout the actual trip?
needs.cadence: Each model cycle; shared cache rather than a full request per visitor.
needs.must_not_infer: Two delivery services for one model are not independent forecasts.

needs.name: Combined seas, swell components and chop
needs.question: How large, steep and crossed are the seas?
needs.cadence: Each model cycle.
needs.must_not_infer: Wave components do not add arithmetically, and surface waves do not establish bottom current.

needs.name: Observed buoy seas
needs.question: How are actual conditions comparing with the forecast?
needs.cadence: 30-minute cloud refresh; 5-minute app check.
needs.must_not_infer: Today's observations do not validate a seven-day forecast.

needs.name: Observed wind and visibility
needs.question: What is being measured now, and where?
needs.cadence: 5–30 minutes according to station updates.
needs.must_not_infer: An inland airport is not an offshore wind observation.

needs.name: Water-level predictions and observations
needs.question: What will the water level be at the reference station?
needs.cadence: Predictions daily; observations 5–30 minutes.
needs.must_not_infer: High or low water is not slack current; a nearby station is not a harbor-bar current station.

needs.name: Observed or modeled surface currents
needs.question: Which way is the upper ocean moving?
needs.cadence: Hourly when the source updates.
needs.must_not_infer: Upper-ocean current is not bottom drift, windage or a safe boat setup position.

needs.name: Bottom temperature, oxygen and water-column structure
needs.question: Are the depth-specific water conditions suitable?
needs.cadence: Model cycles or observed profiles.
needs.must_not_infer: Surface temperature cannot substitute for bottom temperature or oxygen.

needs.name: Sea surface temperature and fronts
needs.question: Where are dated water-mass boundaries worth investigating?
needs.cadence: Daily latest valid satellite analysis.
needs.must_not_infer: A sharp gradient in an interpolated image does not confirm a fish-bearing front.

needs.name: Surface ocean color and productivity context
needs.question: Where is surface productivity observed?
needs.cadence: Daily when cloud-free coverage exists.
needs.must_not_infer: Chlorophyll is not bait biomass or immediate feeding activity.

needs.name: Species-identified survey observations
needs.question: Has the target species been observed in comparable habitat?
needs.cadence: New survey releases; quarterly discovery.
needs.must_not_infer: An opportunistic presence point cannot establish abundance, absence elsewhere or current catch probability.

needs.name: Species-specific catches with fishing effort
needs.question: How did comparable trips perform, including zero-catch trips?
needs.cadence: Daily reported facts; consented trip logs after trips.
needs.must_not_infer: Landing totals, reported limits and successful posts lack the denominator needed for bite probability.

needs.name: Verified charter vessel identities
needs.question: Does this MMSI belong to a local sportfishing operator?
needs.cadence: Monthly identity review; preserve changes in ownership and names.
needs.must_not_infer: Name similarity, AIS type or a home port alone is not verified charter identity.

needs.name: Dated vessel movement and reception coverage
needs.question: Where did a verified boat repeatedly linger?
needs.cadence: Monthly archive availability; incremental import of new dates.
needs.must_not_infer: Slow speed is apparent activity, not proof of fishing or catches; daily sparse positions cannot reconstruct stops.

needs.name: Harbor, entrance and navigation notices
needs.question: Is departure and return access workable for this boat?
needs.cadence: Daily notices and direct recheck before departure.
needs.must_not_infer: A general harbor webpage is not live entrance clearance.

needs.name: Wind forecast ensemble
needs.question: Wind forecast ensemble available for this region?
needs.cadence: Shared 30-minute cloud collection; original source times retained.
needs.must_not_infer: Member agreement is not calibration or independent-hour probability.

needs.name: Wave exceedance ensemble
needs.question: Wave exceedance ensemble available for this region?
needs.cadence: Shared 30-minute cloud collection; original source times retained.
needs.must_not_infer: Published thresholds must not be relabeled as the boat preference.

needs.name: Prospective local forecast verification
needs.question: Prospective local forecast verification available for this region?
needs.cadence: Shared 30-minute cloud collection; original source times retained.
needs.must_not_infer: Do not reconstruct past forecasts, leak future observations or automatically apply an unvalidated correction.

needs.name: Seasonal climate context
needs.question: Which current climate advisory may affect species distributions?
needs.cadence: Daily source check; monthly issued NOAA advisory.
needs.must_not_infer: ENSO does not locate fish, measure local temperature or authorize fishing.
